title: every post shows a picture, and every Page can have a Page picture

criteria.text: Every Page, any kind, may set one optional Page picture; same flow and copy
criteria.note: `groups.picture_url`; `group.update`/`update_draft` take `pictureUrl`; "Page picture" picker in `PageEditor` for all kinds [V] Checked: yes (`update.test`, `update-draft.test`, `PageEditor.test`).

criteria.text: No Page picture shows the kind's placeholder, same for everyone
criteria.note: `DefaultArt` by kind on the Page and the post card [V] Checked: no marker (#632).

criteria.text: A post may carry one photo; a second is refused
criteria.note: `page_posts.photo_url`, single `photoUrl` (never a list) [V build log + code] Checked: yes (`post.test`, `PagePosts.test`).

criteria.text: A post's photo belongs to that post, never becomes the Page's photo
criteria.note: create touches no `groups` row [V] Checked: yes (`post.test`, create path only; edit is not asserted).

criteria.text: Existing upload path: WebP, stripped, own folder, 5 MB, bytes verified
criteria.note: `isOwnMediaUrl` on picture and post photo; WebP/5 MB/bytes come from the reused `PagePhotoPicker` and F070 path [A, not re-read] Checked: yes (own folder; the rest is F070's).

criteria.text: Every post card shows exactly one image: post photo, else Page picture, else placeholder
criteria.note: `browse_feed` resolves it in SQL with `photo_source`; Page cards the same; `/` now redirects to Explore, so Home is Explore [V] Checked: yes (`BrowseResultCard.test`, `PagePosts.test`).

criteria.text: Visible = not hidden, not removed, resolved in SQL; URL never reaches the browser
criteria.note: SQL `case` on `photo_hidden_at`/`removed_at` and picture equivalents [V]; nothing asserts it, only a one-time Visibility review Checked: no (#633).

criteria.text: Each image reportable on its own; hides that one image; notice names which
Adding either image shows the sensitive-content ask at upload
criteria.note: both pickers are `PagePhotoPicker` (F080 ask) [V] Checked: no (marker covers the post photo only) (#632).

criteria.text: Every image has alt text: Page name, or the owner's words, else default
criteria.note: Page picture and placeholder: Page name; post photo: first line of the post; Explore card falls back to the title/when/place default [V]. Whether "owner's words" means the first line is [A] Checked: yes (`BrowseResultCard.test`, `PagePosts.test`).

criteria.text: Signed out: no post photo in any response; Page picture/placeholder where the name shows
criteria.note: Half built: `browse_feed` returns no post rows when `auth.uid()` is null [V]. Missing: the withheld card still draws the Page's `photo_url` (`withheld-announcements.ts`), not the Page picture, and F070's placeholder there is open (#335). The scenario also says that card is "unchanged", which conflicts Checked: no (#633 for the post-photo half).

criteria.text: Removing either image records an event; gone on next load
Current Page photo stays; Page picture starts empty
criteria.note: `photo_url` untouched; `picture_url` new column, null by default [V] Checked: yes (`PageEditor.test`).
